units.source_text: ……我心中仿佛看到这张护符封锁着被禁锢的火的苍白影子。

en.t: ...In my mind, I seemed to see this talisman sealing away the pale shadow of an imprisoned fire.

units.source_text: 昔日显赫一时的东西，如今躲在陈旧的护符后面，呈现出一种苍白、隐隐的病弱的状态。

en.t: What had once blazed with brief splendor now hid behind the old talisman, taking on a pale, faintly sickly state.

units.source_text: 如果说我近来对火的幻想使我泛起了肉欲的感觉，人们会相信吗？

en.t: Would people believe me if I said that my recent fantasies about fire had stirred sensual feelings in me?

units.source_text: 如果说我的生的意志全部寄托在火上，肉欲也冲着火，这不是很自然吗？

en.t: If all my will to live was entrusted to fire, was it not only natural that my desire, too, should turn toward fire?

units.source_text: 而且，我的这种欲望，造成火的织协姿态，火焰透过黑亮的往于，使我意识到所看到的东西，

en.t: Moreover, this desire of mine shaped the interwoven form of fire, and through the black, glossy surface the flames made me conscious of what I was seeing,

units.source_text: 仿佛经过梳妆打扮，优美得很。

en.t: as though it had been combed, adorned, and made exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 它的手、它的脚、它的胸脯都是柔软纤弱的。

en.t: Its hands, its feet, and its breast were all soft and delicate.
